sources.review: Existing generated still re-inspected at full size. Face/eye target, natural skin/clothing, visible hand contact and support are suitable starting constraints. Desktop uses keyboard navigation because no mouse exists in still; mouse hand transfer and laptop trackpad transfer remain animation risks.
